## Tutorials

CSS selectors are used to "find" (or select) the HTML elements you want to 
style.

Use ourCSS Selector Testerto demonstrate the different selectors.

The simple selectors select elements based on element-name, id, and class. In 
addition, there is the universal selector (*).

The attribute selector selects HTML elements with a given attribute set.
